digest.component_or_area: container plan-review attestations and scope inheritance
propositions: A live `none` child must be neutral in drift-scope inheritance, contributing no paths and not poisoning sibling path declarations.
Any live `undeclared` child must poison child inheritance, preventing inherited child paths and blocking all-none classification.
`all_none` classification requires at least one live child with every live child authenticated as `none`; no live children yields false.
Mixed live `paths` and `none` children must sign only path-child dependencies and survive unrelated file drift.
Cheap resign must preserve child-derived signed scope using immutable relation snapshot without network reads.
P9 must pass declared-none leaves and all-declared containers, advising only live undeclared children with path-declaration and `--none` remedies.
